question:
Recently the following error ocurs when running DBT on Azure Databricks:

Database Error in model un_company_sat (models/2_un/partner/sats/un_company_sat.sql) Couldn't initialize file system for path abfss://dp-ext-fab@stcssdpextfabprd.dfs.core.windows.net/__unitystorage/catalogs/12345678-9abc-4c5f-b4a7-ef123456789a/tables/1bd27775-ca51-435a-8c1a-1042391ac471/part-00000-8121312f-d7a0-4a5b-964a-4c2f4ea4f2ec-c000.snappy.parquet

Has anybody an idea how to fix this error or how to further analyze it?
title: Database Error in model .. Couldn't initialize file system for path
answer:
The error occured becase this table is a shallow clone from another table. The original table was re-created.

To fix this we dropped the table and made another shallow clone.
